mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as improved labor market conditions boost corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: UNRATE doesn't fall below 3.5% or 20-day forward returns not positive despite rate decline.

mechanism_narrative: Co-movement of GDP demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) above their 5-year averages signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive despite both proxies above average.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the CPI inflation index above 2.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened inflation concerns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL doesn't cross above 2.0% or returns not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal tightening monetary policy and labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both increase in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high supply (INDPRO) and low unemployment (UNRATE), S&P 500 forward returns decline over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation concerns in an overheated economy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative in the regime or regime conditions not met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) over the previous quarter triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as stronger economic activity boosts market sentiment.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive despite GDPC1 increase.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (HOUST) and federal funds rate both increasing in the same month trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to conflicting policy signals.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and FEDFUNDS both increase in the same month
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong demand
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative despite both proxies rising.
